onnx_model.architecture: 3-layer toy CNN (Conv5x5 -> ReLU -> Conv5x5 -> ReLU -> Conv2x2 -> Reshape)
onnx_model.model_status: UNSUITABLE_PLACEHOLDER - Graph outputs fixed bias coordinates regardless of image content

identified_defects: 1. road_damage_yolo.onnx is a 61KB 3-layer toy CNN generated by build_onnx_model.py with random Gaussian weights and static bias, producing near-constant output [320, 360, 110, 75].
2. ai_service.py never passed frames to onnx_session in analyze_image, bypassing neural network inference entirely.

3. detect_distress_features in ai_service.py has an overly restrictive gap threshold (max 15px) causing single physical potholes to produce multiple split bounding boxes (e.g. 2 boxes on demo_road_2_pothole.jpg).

4. Strict filtering rules (area_pct > 35.0, upper-plane cutoff dist_from_road_top < 0.25*H, directional enclosure < 30%) reject large, close-up, or curb-adjacent potholes, returning 0 detections and Other / uncertain.
5. Frontend NewReportPage.tsx had a fallback {prediction_confidence ? ... : 85%} displaying 85% confidence even when 0 potholes were detected.
